records.global_scope: No noise-robust survey-wide false-alarm calibration. The fixed-noise 1% allowance is conditional on the released white-only noise model and covers three searches, not the roughly 360 project search records.
records.exceedance_field: validation exceedances of the joint statistic
records.diagnostic_scope: Second-stage joint-noise statistic 18.419 (highest eligible cell, 37.57 d; 18.240 at the fixed-noise period) against threshold 23.001. Largest per-generator plus-one tail across seven declared generators (strong_steep), not pooled; the others range from 17 to 52 of 1024. Conditional on the declared 189-member noise grid and generators; not a survey-wide FAP.
records.robustness_evidence: The released par noise is the chain maximum-posterior sample with its red term (log10 A -14.34, gamma 3.05) removed; restoring it lowers 26.87 to 18.18. Error inflation x1.058 removes the crossing; either of two epochs removed takes it below threshold. Supporting: independent reproduction 26.87 (0.0892 +/- 0.0174 us), amplitude and phase consistent across halves, thirds and quarters, not carried by few epochs, absent from DMX, present in narrowband TOAs of the same observations (23.54). Daily aliases (1.0245, 0.9714 d) fit nearly as well, so the period is not determined. With red noise it remains about 4 sigma locally (0.078 +/- 0.019 us). Achromaticity is not testable with these two bands. Second-stage joint-noise test (noise grid declared before the run, orbit linearised and checked against the nonlinear fit: 18.446): below threshold, with the signal-hypothesis noise on a grid edge.
records.confirmation_evidence: All 459 TOAs are Arecibo. The NANOGrav narrowband reduction shares the observations and is not independent. IPTA DR2 holds only a 9-year subset of the same observations; EPTA, PPTA, MPTA, InPTA, UTMOST and TPA folders hold no J2043+1711 data. No independent timing series on disk.
records.review_provenance: Review performed by a subagent on 2026-11-18 (UTC); the recording agent did not independently rerun its numbers. The second-stage test was run by the recording agent on 2026-11-18 UTC.
